app_fee.value: The 2026/27 call and FAQ mention no application fee. Admitted students pay a regional study tax of EUR 120 to 160 a year.

also.quote: Tassa Regionale per il Diritto allo Studio, di importo variabile tra € 120,00 ed € 160,00 annui

fee_waiver.value: The call and FAQ mention no application fee and no fee waiver.

gre_general.value: GRE is not mandatory for SISSA PhD applicants; the FAQ says certificates are very welcome but not required.
gre_general.quote: Do I need to present a TOEFL, GRE, IELTS or other English proficiency certificates? | It is not mandatory but it will be very welcome.

toefl_min.value: No TOEFL score is required; the FAQ says an English certificate is not mandatory, though welcome.
toefl_min.quote: It is not mandatory but it will be very welcome.

ielts_min.value: No IELTS score is required; the FAQ says an English certificate is not mandatory, though welcome.
ielts_min.quote: It is not mandatory but it will be very welcome.

english_waiver.value: No English test is mandatory, so there is nothing to waive; the pages do not discuss English-medium degrees from India.

also.quote: It is not mandatory but it will be very welcome.

notes: The official PhD courses page lists 12 courses in Physics, Mathematics and Neuroscience. Each course has its own call sheet and exam, so each program record covers one course for its field. The FAQ is undated; the 2027/28 call was not yet published.
